Field.name: InputModel
Field.usage: The IMOD model file to analyze.
Field.manpage: The IMOD model file to analyze. If this option is not entered, the first non-option argument will be used for the input file name. One way or another, the option is required.

Field.name: OutputFile
Field.usage: "The file to write the results to (default=stdout)"
Field.manpage: A file to write the results into. If this option is not entered, the first or second non-option argument will be used as an output file name, depending on whether input file name was entere as a non-option argument. If no output file is defined, results will be printed to standard out.

Field.name: CentroidReference
Field.usage: Reference all measurements to the centroid of the specified reference object

Field.name: ContourReference
Field.usage: The index of the contour to use when specifying a point in the reference object, numbered from 1 (default: 1).

Field.name: Measure
Field.usage: The list of objects to measure, numbered from 1

Field.name: PointReference
Field.usage: Reference all measurements to this point (number from 1) in a contour in reference object.
Field.manpage: Reference all measurements to this point in specified contour in the specified reference object. The point number if numbered from 1.

Field.name: ReferenceObject
Field.usage: The object to use for referencing all distance measurements, numbered from 1

Field.name: verbose
Field.usage: Print out information about the objects and models being processed

Field.name: VeryVerbose
Field.usage: Print out lots of debugging information
